answer: Anchor each agent identity to a basalt-hard base: one hardware-attested key earning reputation only via verified work. New identities start at zero, trust builds slowly, and reputation decays when idle, so fake accounts cannot be stockpiled. The delta between claimed and verified output is published, and mismatch slashes reputation. Higher-value work triggers a spiral of rising costs: longer history, larger refundable bonds, and vouchers from established agents who lose standing for endorsing a fake. Mass fakery then costs time and bonds, while one honest agent earns access cheaply.
